label: Bat A
description: The original flying monster bat, with a small dark gray-brown furry rodent body and muzzle, two very large pointed ears with pale pink insides, tiny orange eyes, small pale fangs and pink bony wing fingers. Its enormous leathery wing membranes are deep forest green with brighter muted green upper planes and nearly black green undersides. Preserve the wide angular wing silhouette, thin bony ribs, tiny feet and native hunched flying posture. No feathers, horns, humanoid anatomy, ornaments or extra limbs. Preserve native dark colors and tonal weight; ONLY membranes will later change palette.
